title.value: Technology-enhanced trauma training in low-resource settings: A scoping review and feasibility analysis of educational technologies
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Technology-enhanced trauma training in low-resource settings: A scoping review and feasibility analysis of educational technologies

extractions.description: The paper reviews current technologies used in trauma courses and evaluates their feasibility for low- and lower-middle-income countries (LMICs). It identifies that the majority of trauma courses in the literature use technologies that are less suitable for LMICs and suggests educators must use technologies that optimize learning outcomes and remain feasible for low-resource settings.
